description: This file defines the ProjectActivitySearchFilterParams class in the OrangeHRM Time module, specifically for handling search filters related to project activities. It extends a base FilterParams class and manages a 'projectActivityName' property with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ProjectActivitySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object extending FilterParams, used for specifying search filter parameters for project activities in the OrangeHRM Time module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'projectActivity.name'.

methods.name: getProjectActivityName
methods.description: Returns the current value of the projectActivityName property.

methods.name: setProjectActivityName
methods.description: Sets the value of the projectActivityName property.
